demos.name: Agent Governance LAB
demos.description: AI Platform Agents: a cross-cloud inventory across thirteen sources, a permission review with a five-level score, custodians with administrator approval before any action runs, remediation, a safe sync that never mistakes silence for deletion, AgentCore gateway governance and private-network discovery: a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7300). Docker: HOST_PORT=7300 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; the lab holds no credential for any cloud.
